name: agentic-practices-marketplace
description: Public Claude Code skills and plugins from the Agentic Practices training programmes — audit context, pressure-test ideas, and turn pitches into PRDs.

plugins.name: hackathon-project-pitch
plugins.description: Stress-test a hackathon idea with forcing questions and produce a five-minute, six-slide sponsor-approval pitch — overview.md, presentation.html/pdf, and qanda.md.

plugins.name: prd-from-pitch
plugins.description: Turn a project pitch or feature idea into a scored PRD and Dave Farley-style user story files with pass/no-pass acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: claude-md-auditor
plugins.description: Audit CLAUDE.md setups for context quality, scope, currency, hierarchy, deterministic enforcement, and maintainability, then offer explicitly approved improvements.

plugins.name: setup-statusline
plugins.description: Adapt a reference context-window statusline to your OS and wire it into your Claude Code settings via /setupstatusline.
